description: Advance the debuggers' simulation clock (%advance), running every state event, action token, change-condition poll and do behavior that comes due, in due order, and report what ran and where the debuggers stand. The clock is the session's: a debugged action and machine both move.

session.description: session name; omit for the default session

time.description: time units (seconds) to advance the debuggers' clock by, running every event, token and do behavior that comes due; 0 dispatches what is already due

name: advance

breakpoints.description: action: the nodes breakpoints are set at

currentState.description: state machine: the active state, or one per orthogonal region

kind.description: action or state for the executor described (with both debugged, the one still running, else the action); check when the behavior was checked over every schedule rather than stepped; empty when no debugging session runs

pausedAt.description: action: the breakpoint the run last stopped at

results.description: action: the values its features hold, outputs included

signalsInFlight.description: signals sent and not yet dispatched to the machine

state.description: the executor's state as the prompt prints it: Ready, Running, Waiting, Suspended, Completed or Terminated

arrivedFrom.description: at a join, the node the token came from

awaiting.description: at a join, the nodes whose tokens are still awaited

node.description: the node the token sits at
